items.title: Create custom monitors in Vercel Observability
items.summary: You can now create custom monitors to get alerts based on your  results. Vercel Observability queryFor example, you can track signals such as AI Gateway costs, Core Web Vitals and other performance metrics, Workflow and external API failure rates, or Vercel Sandbox CPU time.Each monitor tracks a single metric, such as response time, or a ratio of two metrics, such as errors divided by total requests. Choose statistical anomaly detection or a fixed threshold, then configure the detection window, filters, and grouping.To create a monitor, inspect a chart’s query in Observability, start from a preset, or open  for your team. Settings > AlertsYou can also create custom monitors from a JSON configuration with  in the . You can also add context for  to use when investigating an alert.Vercel AgentCustom monitors are available on Pro and Enterprise plans with Observability Plus, at $0.0035 per GB of data scanned.
